_comment: The menu. Prices are in dollars. 'daily' items are baked every open day; others list the days they're available. 'holiday' is the seasonal pre-order panel: set show to false to hide it. Its items have no prices yet; add a price to an item and it will appear.

sections.title: Bread
sections.note: Naturally leavened, fermented 36 hours. Sliced on request.

items.name: Country Sourdough
items.description: Our house loaf. Blistered crust, open crumb, a little tang.

items.name: Seeded Rye
items.description: Forty percent whole rye with sunflower, flax, and toasted sesame.

items.name: Juniper Levain
items.description: Crushed juniper and orange zest. Our namesake, and the reason regulars come on Fridays.

sections.title: Pastry
sections.note: Laminated by hand with cultured butter.

items.name: Butter Croissant
items.description: Three days from dough to case. Flaky all the way through.

items.name: Cardamom Bun
items.description: Swedish-style knot, fresh-ground cardamom, pearl sugar.

items.name: Seasonal Fruit Danish
items.description: Whatever the orchard down the road has this week.

items.name: Chocolate Rye Cookie
items.description: Dark chocolate, rye flour, flaky salt. Chewy in the middle.

sections.title: Coffee & tea
sections.note: Beans roasted locally. Oat milk at no charge.

items.name: Cortado
items.description: Equal parts espresso and steamed milk.
